title: Slice 4 — Real transit (BKK FUTÁR) — docs/plans/magic-mirror/04-slices.md
acceptance: The transit section is populated from the BKK FUTÁR API for configured stops
Unit tests cover the realtime-vs-scheduled distinction (SCHEDULED vs ON TIME)
The BKK API key is read only from the MIRROR_BKK_API_KEY environment variable and never appears in API JSON or config files
The transit refresh interval is independently configurable
